Empires & Puzzles Knuckles Review: 4-Star Ice Blue Hero from Jungle Hunter Family

Knuckles isn't just monkeying around. This 4-star Paladin brings a mechanic almost exclusive to him: reflecting negative stacks. Is this niche ability enough to earn him a spot on your roster, or is he just another average speed hero? We break down his stats, skills, and best use cases.
Knuckles Review: The Monkey King of Reflection
Knuckles, The Macaque Sentinel: Reflecting Stacks with Jungle Fury

Knuckles is a 4-star Epic Ice (Blue) hero from the Jungle Hunter family, originally released around May 2023. As a Paladin, his primary job is survival, but his kit suggests a more mischievous role: turning your opponent's nastiest tricks back against them. While he might look like he's ready to star in a "Journey to the West" adaptation, in Empires & Puzzles, he serves as a specific counter-measure to some of the most annoying mechanics in the game: ailments and, uniquely, stacks.

The artwork for Knuckles is vibrant and full of character. He sports a "Macaque Sentinel" look, complete with tribal armor and a fierce, toothy expression that says, "I might be a monkey, but I will absolutely ruin your day." The color palette is a mix of icy blues and jungle greens, fitting his element and family perfectly. It's a dynamic pose that suggests agility and aggression, which ironically contrasts with his purely defensive and reflective special skill. He definitely stands out compared to the generic knights and wizards of the classic era.

With a base power of 687 (and reaching 844 at LB2), Knuckles sits comfortably in the "modern 4-star" bracket, though he is starting to trail behind the very latest power-creeped releases (like the Construct or Opera 4-stars which push 700+ base power).

The Jungle Hunter family bonus (bonus for unique heroes) usually provides stats or mana generation. While nice, in a 4-star team, you are unlikely to run a full rainbow of Jungle Hunters, so treat this as a minor perk rather than a build-around feature.

The community reaction to Knuckles was mixed but hopeful.
One user pointed out his specific niche:
"He will shine vs Skadi in minion wars. All allies reflect negative stacks. I haven’t seen stacks reflected before."
"Sounds like food for Snow White to me!"
"I only use him in rush against Alfrike tanks. I don’t think he does enough otherwise."
Historically, he hasn't broken the game, but he has saved many players from the frustration of permanent stack ailments.

Knuckles is the definition of a "tool" hero. You don't buy a hammer to brush your teeth, and you don't bring Knuckles to a tile-damage fight. But when you need to hammer a nail (or reflect a nasty stack of poison), he is the best tool in the box. While his stats are aging and his speed is average, his unique ability to reflect stacks ensures he will have a seat at the table—especially the 4-star table—for a long time.
A solid Keeper for tournaments and specific counters. Don't go bananas summoning for him, but if you have him, treat him well.
